name: NitroMcpUpload
description: Uploads a MCP Feature collection to the Nitro registry.
author: ChilliCream

inputs.name: tag
inputs.label: Tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: The tag of the MCP feature collection version.

inputs.name: mcpFeatureCollectionId
inputs.label: MCP feature collection ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ID of the MCP feature collection.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for authentication. Use a secret pipeline variable: `$(NITRO_API_KEY)`.

inputs.name: promptPatterns
inputs.label: Prompt patterns
inputs.helpMarkDown: Glob patterns matching MCP prompt files (one per line). At least one of `promptPatterns` or `toolPatterns` is required.

inputs.name: toolPatterns
inputs.label: Tool patterns
inputs.helpMarkDown: Glob patterns matching MCP tool files (one per line). At least one of `promptPatterns` or `toolPatterns` is required.

inputs.name: cloudUrl
inputs.label: Cloud URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL of the Nitro registry.
